identity.target_audience: Strategy Consultant, Banking Executive, Chief Strategy Officer, Head of Retail Banking, Network Planning Head, Digital Banking Head
identity.visual_character: McKinsey/BCG-style executive decision-support system, data-heavy consulting analytics platform, natural professional data-analyst presentation. Avoids generic AI chatbot look, student dashboards, or excessive rounded gradients.
identity.theme_mode: Light Main Canvas (#F4F7FB) with Deep Navy (#071426) Executive Sidebar and High-Contrast Data Cards

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

footer_meta.public_sources: RBI Reports, Census 2011/2026 Est., NPCI Data, Bank Financial Disclosures

ui_components_guidelines.tables: Dense, clean, fixed header, alternating row tinting on hover, subtle 1px border (#DFE7F0), clear column alignment (text left, numbers right).
ui_components_guidelines.kpi_cards: White card (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#DFE7F0), top accent indicator bar, metric value in 2xl bold, percentage delta with green/red indicator, source badge at bottom.
ui_components_guidelines.charts: Recharts with customized palette (#1687F8, #27C3E8, #7657D9, #16A36A, #E79B24), clean grid lines (#DFE7F0), rich custom tooltips showing reporting period and exact numbers.
ui_components_guidelines.modals_and_reports: In-browser print view styled for A4 executive briefing export with page break management and high-resolution chart rendering.

testing_requirements.rule: Every button, link, tab, filter, modal trigger, card, select dropdown, chart container, and report generator MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-quality web app for BranchIQ in React standard frontend.
Ensure all hex values strictly match the specified color system.
Do NOT use cartoon AI avatars or generic chatbot layouts; use executive consulting agent cards.
Ensure the bank selector updates all metrics, charts, and recommendations dynamically.
Support full PDF/Print export for the Executive Report button.
Ensure seamless responsive behavior on screens down to 768px and mobile.
